name: unleashwp-ai-forge
description: Turn a date window into a release-post changelog for WordPress Core + Gutenberg, right inside Claude Desktop.
long_description: UnleashWP AI Forge is a hub for WordPress release tooling. This bundle registers Forge as an MCP server so Claude can call its tools live — get_changelog, list_milestones, list_branches, show_changelog — and open the full Forge app as a window. Optional credentials raise the GitHub API limit and enable deep mode (full Trac ticket text).

github_token.title: GitHub token (optional)
github_token.description: Raises the GitHub API limit from 60 to 5,000 requests/hour. No scopes needed — Forge only reads public repos. Leave empty to run at 60/hour.

trac_cookie.title: WordPress.org cookie (optional)
trac_cookie.description: Enables deep mode: full Trac ticket text. Paste 'wporg_logged_in=…; wporg_sec=…' from a logged-in wordpress.org session. Stored by Claude Desktop; sent only to WordPress.org.
